Faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subheading: Everything you need to know before joining the partner program.
Faq.q1: How do I start as an IB or marketing partner?
Faq.a1: Create a free account in minutes. Once approved, you get an agent code and referral links you can share right away.
Faq.a2: We offer Revenue Share up to 60%, a fixed amount per qualified client (CPA), plus a multi-tier Sub-IB system.
Faq.q3: When and how do I receive my earnings?
Faq.a3: Your earnings accrue automatically in your wallet, and you can request withdrawals via bank transfer, crypto, or e-wallets — processed quickly and transparently.
Faq.q4: How do I track my referral performance?
Faq.a4: From the dashboard you track clicks, signups, trading volume, and earnings per campaign through live charts and detailed tables.
Faq.a5: Yes. We enforce strict row-level security (RLS) in the database, so your data is isolated and only you can access it.

HowItWorks.heading: Your role is clear — ours is clearer
HowItWorks.subheading: We're the third party between the client/agent and the brokers — we handle the negotiating, pooling and payouts on your behalf.
HowItWorks.s1Desc: We negotiate tighter spreads and higher rates with licensed brokers — terms you can't get by signing up directly.
HowItWorks.s2Desc: We aggregate our whole network's trading volume, so your commission is calculated at master level, not as a single agent.
HowItWorks.s3Desc: Every agent's earnings post automatically to their wallet, with live tracking of each click, referral and trade.
HowItWorks.s4Desc: An Arabic-speaking team walks the trader and the agent from sign-up to withdrawal, around the clock.
HowItWorks.roleClientDesc: We connect you to the right licensed broker on terms we negotiated for you — at no extra cost.
HowItWorks.roleAgentDesc: Join as an agent under the master umbrella and earn higher rates with a Sub-IB network and full support.
